## Overview

A sample portfolio page using semantic headings, optimized images, and the shared button component. Use it as a starting point for a personal site or project showcase.

## Customize the page

1. Replace the name and introduction with your own content.
2. Add your project images with meaningful alternative text.
3. Update the navigation and call to action to point to your work.
4. Adjust the spacing and theme to suit your brand.

## Usage

The example source is in `docs/templates/portfolio.mdx`. Copy it into your application and update its imports to match your installed components.

```tsx
<h2>Thoughtful design. Useful software.</h2>
<p>I create accessible digital experiences.</p>
<Image src="/project.jpg" alt="Project overview" width={800} height={400} />
```

This is a composition example, not an installable full project template. Browse [blocks](/blocks) and [components](/components) to extend it.
